name: Garlic Butter Noodles
instructions: Cook the noodles in boiling water until just tender, then drain and keep a mugful of the water.
Melt the butter with the oil and cook the garlic and chilli gently for 2 minutes.
Stir in the soy sauce and honey and let it bubble for 30 seconds.
Add the noodles with a splash of the cooking water and toss until glossy.
Finish off the heat with the spring onion, parmesan and a good grind of black pepper.
